{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Grey suit jacket: single-breasted, tailored fit, hip length, grey (#8A8D91), textured wool blend

Grey suit trousers: straight leg, full length with a slight taper at the ankle, matching grey (#8A8D91), wool blend of the same fabric as the jacket

Blouse: classic collar with a softly concealed placket, long sleeves, hip-skimming tuck-in length, ivory (#F3EFE6), crepe or silk-blend fabric

Ankle boots: low block heel, almond toe, smooth finish, black (#1E1E1E), leather

Earrings: silver drop earrings with a polished finish, small to medium size, silver (#C0C0C0), sterling silver

Belt: slim, simple silver-tone buckle, black (#1E1E1E), leather

Autumn weather calls for a suit with some weight, so the grey wool-blend jacket and trousers give warmth without needing a coat on top. The ivory blouse brightens the neutral grey and keeps the look neat and professional for a workday. Black ankle boots and a matching belt ground the outfit and keep it polished. The silver earrings are the one point of emphasis, and they pick up the cool tone of the grey so the whole look feels cohesive."}
